name: skills
description: Portable skills for code review, security audits, implementation, dependency upgrades, desktop releases, Vercel domains, repository cleanup, AI tool setup and maintenance, and clear communication.

interface.longDescription: Review code with evidence, audit code and repository security, remove unnecessary complexity, upgrade dependencies with migrations and verification, and communicate clearly at the requested level of detail. Set up signed public GitHub releases with automatic updates and separate development apps, or private releases with licensed updates and device administration. Fix Vercel production and www redirects, reconcile DNS, and verify websites. Inventory and clean generated repository artifacts, save Omarchy window layouts, and manage AI tools and JavaScript runtimes with OS-aware setup, confirmation for missing installs, verified updates, and a complete status report.
defaultPrompt: Review these changes with the code-review skill.
Implement this with the code-build skill.
Audit this repository and its GitHub Actions with the code-security skill.
Update dependencies and apply required migrations with the upgrade-dependencies skill.
Explain this with the make-sense skill.
Write explanations, instructions, and reports with the simplify skill.
Set up private desktop distribution with the private-desktop-release skill.
Set up and publish this app with the public-desktop-release skill.
Fix production redirects and DNS warnings with the vercel-domain-cleanup skill.
Inventory generated artifacts with the repo-disk-cleanup skill.
Save my Omarchy window layout with the save-window-layout skill.
Set up missing AI tools with confirmation and update existing tools with the ai-harness-setup skill.
